selection_request.description: Orient the business model, risks and segment economics from available annual or interim operating reports. Prefer annual background and latest interim when available; source presence does not prove every fact was visible or answered.
selection_request.query: business operations segments products services customers risks

scope: Fixed25 already-bound root recent variants only. Aware accepted_at <= original cutoff and existing filing-date lookback; native operating_order annual/interim preference. Direct exact filename exists checks in cache directories derived from prior inventory; no second filename census or linked archive traversal. Exact same-ID oracle paths across namespaces additionally checked for LEU/TNDM only. No GET, normalization products, global store construction, append, labels, model or admission.
limitations: Root recent only; missing annual/interim is bounded not global absence. Linked archive files are not fetched or scanned.
Form/period/acceptance mechanics do not prove full operating content or resolve independent source clock conflicts. All targets remain candidates.
Missing roots or changed variants do not authorize favorable-source selection. Existing original identity collisions remain candidates and are never overwritten.
